scores.tell: Lamp post and dome are uniformly smooth satin metal with soft gradients; glass glow is clean but the metal lacks the small stylized highlights and material variety of real cards.
Green canvas has fine weave speckle and stitched seams, close to the towel/saddle detail; aluminium tubes are slightly uniform and a bit plastic.
Fabric has stitching and mild grain, but the chunky grey tube joints and feet read as glossy plastic with the same sheen as the cloth.
Plastic bottles and wood tabletop have a good matte/gloss mix and soft grain like real cards; only the bottle highlights are slightly even.
Whole helmet and base are one smooth lacquered, porcelain-like surface with a big glossy visor; no micro texture, and the shiny tabletop has plastic-like reflections.
Painterly foliage, wood and bark with soft detail match the real swing card; the bark and roof grooves are slightly busy.
Red leather gloves have a good soft sheen and a matte black strap, but the gloss is quite uniform and no stitching or seams show.
Wooden pier posts have fine grain and rope detail; the water has busy caustic sparkle and the wood is slightly plasticky.
Glossy orange plastic rim and flat clock face are very clean; everything is smooth lacquer with no fine texture and a single gloss level.
Fabric has fine weave and stitches, as in c142, but the metal tubes are a little chrome-shiny and the joints are chunky.
